scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 54-bet): rasm yorliqlari 45 ta - pear, strawberries, coconut, pineapple, cherries, bananas, orange, apple, grapes, wine, coffee, beer, orange juice, milk, water, tea, chocolate cake, ice-cream, apple pie, biscuits, bread, cheese, lettuce, pepper, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, onion, garlic, salad, tomato soup, hamburger, chips, crisps, steak, pizza, rice, grilled fish, sausage, hot-dog, egg, bacon, pasta, tomato sauce, roast chicken - JSON bilan to'liq mos, biror so'z qolmagan. Ex.1 a-e savollari va Ex.2 moslashtirish (1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-e, 5-b) mantiqan yagona yechim, audiosiz ham topiladi. Xato topilmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the names of the foods and drinks.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga va ovqat hamda ichimlik nomlariga qarang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — OVQAT.

Sarlavha: 'Enjoy your Meal'
  = Yoqimli ishtaha! Ovqatingizdan zavqlaning!
  Bu — restoranda ofitsiant aytadigan ibora.
  Fransuzchada 'Bon appétit', o'zbekchada 'Yoqimli ishtaha'.

BETDAGI SO'ZLAR BEShTA GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  MEVALAR (fruit):
    pear, strawberries, coconut, pineapple, cherries,
    bananas, orange, apple, grapes

  ICHIMLIKLAR (drinks):
    wine, coffee, beer, orange juice, milk, water, tea

  SHIRINLIKLAR (sweets/desserts):
    chocolate cake, ice-cream, apple pie, biscuits

  SABZAVOTLAR (vegetables):
    lettuce, pepper, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes,
    onion, garlic

  TAOMLAR (dishes):
    tomato soup, hamburger, chips, steak, pizza, rice,
    grilled fish, sausage, crisps, hot-dog, egg, bacon,
    pasta, tomato sauce, roast chicken, salad, bread, cheese

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and answer the questions below.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va quyidagi savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH SAVOL:
  a — qaysi ovqat/ichimlikni yoqtirasiz/yoqtirmaysiz? (SHAXSIY)
  b — qaysilari sabzavot/go'sht/meva/shirinlik? (ANIQ)
  c — nonushta/tushlik/kechki ovqatni qachon yeysiz? (SHAXSIY)
  d — mevani/shirinlikni/sabzavotni/go'shtni qanchalik
      tez-tez yeysiz? (SHAXSIY)
  e — qaysi ovqat/ichimlikni nonushtaga/shirinlikka/yengil
      ovqatga/an'anaviy ingliz nonushtasiga olish mumkin? (ANIQ)

SHAXSIY savollarga namuna javoblar berilgan —
o'zingizga moslab o'zgartiring.

items.textEn: a  Which of the foods/drinks do you like?
items.answer: I like pizza, ice-cream, grapes and orange juice.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. Sanashda oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and'.
O'zingiz yoqtirgan ovqatlarni ayting.

items.textEn: a  Which of the foods/drinks don't you like?
items.answer: I don't like coconut, garlic or beer.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
DIQQAT: INKOR gapda sanashda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi.

items.answer: Lettuce, pepper, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, onion and garlic are vegetables.
items.hintUz: Yerda o'sadigan, taom uchun ishlatiladigan o'simliklar
items.whyUz:
SABZAVOTLAR — rasmda o'ng tomonda joylashgan.
DIQQAT: pomidor botanik jihatdan MEVA, lekin oshxonada
SABZAVOT hisoblanadi.

items.answer: Steak, sausage, hot-dog, bacon, roast chicken and hamburger are meat.
items.whyUz:
GO'SHT taomlari — rasmda pastki qatorda.
'meat' — sanalmaydigan ot ('meats' odatda ishlatilmaydi).

items.answer: Pear, strawberries, coconut, pineapple, cherries, bananas, orange, apple and grapes are fruit.
items.hintUz: Daraxt va butalarda o'sadigan shirin mahsulotlar
items.whyUz:
MEVALAR — rasmda chap yuqori burchakda.
'fruit' — odatda SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'I eat a lot of fruit.'
'fruits' faqat turli TURLARI haqida.

items.answer: Chocolate cake, ice-cream, apple pie and biscuits are sweets.
items.whyUz:
SHIRINLIKLAR — rasmda chap o'rta qismda.
'sweets' = shirinliklar (britancha); amerikacha 'candy'.

items.textEn: c  When do you eat breakfast?
items.answer: I eat breakfast at seven o'clock in the morning.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
'have breakfast' ham to'g'ri: 'I have breakfast at seven.'
DIQQAT: 'breakfast' oldida artikl KERAK EMAS.

items.textEn: c  When do you eat lunch?
items.answer: I eat lunch at one o'clock in the afternoon.

items.textEn: c  When do you eat dinner?
items.answer: I eat dinner at seven o'clock in the evening.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. 'dinner' — kunning asosiy ovqati,
odatda kechqurun.

items.textEn: d  How often do you eat fruit?
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
Chastota ifodalari: every day, twice a week, once a month,
always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

items.textEn: d  How often do you eat sweets?
items.answer: I eat sweets twice a week.
items.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. 'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta.

items.textEn: d  How often do you eat vegetables?
d  How often do you eat meat?
items.answer: I eat meat three or four times a week.
items.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. '... times a week' — haftasiga ... marta.

items.textEn: e  Which of the foods/drinks can you have for breakfast?
items.answer: You can have eggs, bacon, bread, cheese, coffee, tea, milk or orange juice for breakfast.
items.whyUz:
'have ... FOR breakfast' — 'for' predlogi shart.
Nonushtaga yengil va tez tayyorlanadigan taomlar olinadi.

items.textEn: e  Which of the foods can you have for dessert?
items.answer: You can have ice-cream, chocolate cake, apple pie, biscuits or fruit for dessert.
items.whyUz:
'dessert' /dɪˈzɜːt/ = shirinlik (ovqatdan keyin).
DIQQAT: 'desert' /ˈdezət/ = cho'l — boshqa so'z!

items.textEn: e  Which of the foods can you have for a light meal?
items.answer: You can have salad, tomato soup, a sandwich or grilled fish for a light meal.
items.whyUz:
'a light meal' = yengil ovqat (aksi: 'a heavy meal').
Salat va sho'rva — eng yengil taomlar.

items.textEn: e  Which of the foods can you have for a traditional English breakfast?
items.answer: You can have eggs, bacon, sausages, tomatoes, bread and tea for a traditional English breakfast.
items.hintUz: An'anaviy ingliz nonushtasi — issiq va to'yimli
items.whyUz:
AN'ANAVIY INGLIZ NONUSHTASI (a full English breakfast):
  qovurilgan tuxum, bekon, sosiska, pomidor, loviya,
  qovurilgan non va choy.
Bu — dunyodagi eng to'yimli nonushtalardan biri.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and match the numbers to the letters.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va raqamlarni harflarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 'Laura's' degan yangi restoran haqidagi reklama.

Moslikni GRAMMATIKA va MANTIQ bilan topish mumkin —
audio faqat tekshirish uchun:

  1 'The new family restaurant' — ega, kesim kerak
     → 'is on Bridge Street' (joy)
  2 'The food is' — 'is' bor, sifat kerak
     → 'very well cooked'
  3 'A meal for two' — ega, narx kerak
     → 'costs about £25'
  4 'The service' — ega, kesim kerak
     → 'is excellent'
  5 'Laura's is open' — ish vaqti kerak
     → 'from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening'

DIQQAT — 'Laura's':
  Restoran nomi egalik apostrofi bilan — 'Lauraniki'.
  Inglizchada restoran va do'kon nomlari ko'pincha shunday:
  McDonald's, Sainsbury's, Harrod's.

pairs.whyUz:
Restoran — JOY talab qiladi.
'ON + ko'cha nomi' — ko'cha oldida ON.
'a family restaurant' = oilaviy restoran (bolalar bilan borish mumkin).

'The food IS' — 'is' allaqachon bor → sifat/sifatdosh kerak.
'well cooked' = yaxshi pishirilgan.
'well' — ravish ('good cooked' XATO).

'A meal' — birlik ega → fe'l -S bilan: COSTS.
'a meal for two' = ikki kishilik ovqat.
'£25' = 'twenty-five pounds' deb o'qiladi.

'The service' — ega, kesim kerak → 'is excellent'.
'service' = xizmat ko'rsatish (ofitsiantlar ishi).
'excellent' = a'lo, zo'r.

pairs.right: b  from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
pairs.rightUz: ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha.
pairs.whyUz:
'is open' — ISH VAQTI kerak.
'from ... till ...' = ...dan ...gacha.
'till' = 'until' ning qisqa shakli.

wordFormation.introUz: 54-bet — ovqat otlarining sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan turlari.

groups.explanationUz: Bu otlarga -s qo'shilmaydi va 'a/an' ishlatilmaydi. Fe'l BIRLIKDA.
Bu otlarga 'a/an' qo'shiladi va ko'plik shakli bor.
Undoshdan keyin -y kelsa, y → i va -es qo'shiladi.
Ikki so'z birikib yangi taom nomini yasaydi.
Bir narsa, ikki nom — chalkashish mumkin!
Fe'ldan yasalgan sifat — ot oldida turadi.

patterns.formula: I like / I don't like + ovqat.
patterns.exampleEn: I like pizza and ice-cream. I don't like coconut or garlic.
patterns.exampleUz: Menga pitsa va muzqaymoq yoqadi. Kokos va sarimsoq yoqmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: TASDIQ gapda sanashda 'and', INKOR gapda 'OR' ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: X, Y and Z are + guruh nomi.
patterns.exampleEn: Carrots, potatoes and onions are vegetables.
patterns.explanationUz: Turkumlashda ega ham, guruh nomi ham KO'PLIKDA.

patterns.formula: When do you eat/have + ovqat? — At + soat.
patterns.exampleEn: When do you eat breakfast? — At seven o'clock in the morning.
patterns.exampleUz: Nonushtani qachon qilasiz? — Ertalab soat yettida.
patterns.explanationUz:
'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner' oldida ARTIKL KERAK EMAS.
Aniq soat oldida AT.

patterns.formula: How often do you eat + ovqat? — every day / twice a week.
patterns.exampleEn: How often do you eat fruit? — I eat fruit every day.
patterns.exampleUz: Mevani qanchalik tez-tez yeysiz? — Har kuni yeyman.

patterns.formula: You can have + ovqat + FOR + breakfast/dessert.
patterns.exampleEn: You can have ice-cream for dessert.
Laura's is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Laura's' ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.

patterns.formula: A meal for two COSTS about £25.
patterns.exampleEn: A meal for two costs about £25.
patterns.exampleUz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 25 funt turadi.
